Created in partnership with the Foundation of Greater Montréal, the La Converse Fund represents a unique opportunity to support our initiatives. Thanks to this fund, we can keep making journalism a tool for social change. By telling stories that break stereotypes and shed light on issues and on the realities of communities that are too often made invisible. Le Fonds La Converse, créé en collaborat: The La Converse Fund, created in collaboration with the Foundation of Greater Montréal, aims to support journalism that is human, transparent and inclusive. Each of your contributions helps us to:
Amplifier les voix sous-représentées : V: Amplify underrepresented voices: Your donations give a platform to stories that are often ignored, offering marginalized communities the space to share their reality.
Encourager des dialogues constructifs :: Encourage constructive dialogue: By supporting initiatives for dialogue and exchange, you help build bridges between different communities and strengthen social cohesion.
Renforcer l’indépendance journalistique: Strengthen journalistic independence: Your contributions support projects that aim to offer concrete solutions and to maintain free and independent journalism.
Former et intégrer une relève journalist: Train and integrate a diverse new generation of journalists: Through your donations, you help make journalism accessible to everyone by creating opportunities for talent from all backgrounds.
